agentPrompts.label: Queue a new research question
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-radar` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then queue the research question I ask and draft a brief for it (scope, planned sources, depth, expected deliverable) for my approval before any research runs.

agentPrompts.label: Where is my research pipeline at?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-radar` skill in this folder, then show me every research question and its stage — brief_needs_review, researching, report_ready, or closed.

agentPrompts.label: Ask a follow-up on a finished report
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-radar` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then append the follow-up question I ask onto the report_ready question I name, so it can start another research round.
